Available Summer 2024 · Student Property · Great Location

My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this 5 bedroom student property on popular Sunbury Avenue in Jesmond. The property consists of five bedrooms bedrooms, front lounge, spacious kitchen, two bathrooms, fitted kitchen and downstairs WC. There is also off-street parking. Situated only a stones throw from West Jesmond Metro Station, the terraced house is close to local amenities such as Tesco, Sainsburys and popular bars.
